Industry Visit to Skanray Technologies Pvt. Ltd. — Department of CSE (Data Science)
 
Date of Visit: 12th April 2025
 
Department: Computer Science and Engineering (Data Science) – 4th Semester Students Institution: ATME College of Engineering, Mysuru
 
Industry Visit Convenor  -  Dr. Anitha D B,- Associate Professor & Head , Department of CSE (Data Science)
Accompanying Faculty Members:- Dr. Vinod Kumar P – Associate Professor , Department of CSE (Data Science)
 
The Department of Computer Science and Engineering (Data Science), ATMECE,Mysuru organized an enriching Industrial Visit to Skanray Technologies Pvt. Ltd., Mysuru, a leading innovator in the medical equipment manufacturing industry, on 12th April 2025.
 
During the visit, students gained valuable insights into the design, development, and production of cutting-edge healthcare technologies, including:
  • Advanced ventilators
  • Medical imaging systems
  • Patient monitoring devices
The visit offered students a unique opportunity to witness firsthand how engineering innovation meets real-world healthcare needs through a strong focus on quality, precision, and technological excellence. Interacting with industry professionals and observing real-time processes provided practical exposure that will greatly enhance their academic and professional journeys.
 
The Department extends its heartfelt gratitude to  the entire Skanray Technologies team for their support, guidance, and warm hospitality, making this visit a highly impactful learning experience. Such initiatives help bridge the gap between classroom learning and industry practices, inspiring students to pursue excellence in the evolving field of Medical Technology and Data Science.
